title: What my family does
instructions: Ayşe ailesindeki kişilerin mesleklerini anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; kimin ne iş yaptığını karıştırma.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: There are five people in my family, and everyone has a different job.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: My father is a bus driver. He works very early in the morning and comes home at two.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: My mother works in a bank. She wears smart clothes and uses a computer all day.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: My older brother, Can, is a chef in a hotel. He cooks fantastic fish, but he never cooks at home!

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: My sister, Deniz, is a university student. She wants to be a doctor.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: And me? I am a teacher. I teach English to young children.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: I love my job because the children are funny and every day is different.

script.speaker: ayse
script.text: At the weekend, we all have dinner together at my parents' house.

questions.evidence: My father is a bus driver.

questions.prompt: Who wants to be a doctor?
questions.feedback: Üniversite öğrencisi olan kız kardeşi Deniz doktor olmak istiyor.
questions.evidence: She wants to be a doctor.

questions.feedback: Ayşe öğretmen; küçük çocuklara İngilizce öğretiyor.
